project.description:
This job loads the UniProt data into the database. It will only load the data if there is a new release (as captured by UniProt-Release-Check_d).
Reconciles ZFIN gene <-> UniProtKB accession links against a new UniProt release. New links are matched through a RefSeq accession shared with an existing ZFIN db_link.
INPUT (on disk): the release file downloaded and zebrafish-filtered by UniProt-Release-Check_d, under /research/zarchive/load_files/UniProt-archive/. That job fetches (see zfin.properties): UNIPROT_SPROT_FILE_URL https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?...organism_id:7955...reviewed:true UNIPROT_TREMBL_FILE_URL https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?...organism_id:7955...reviewed:false *_ALT1..3 ftp.expasy.org / ftp.uniprot.org uniprot_{sprot,trembl}_vertebrates.dat.gz UNIPROT_URL_FOR_RELEASE_DATE timestamp probe only
INPUT (external, at run time): https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/ - checks whether UniProt accessions about to be lost correspond to obsoleted RefSeq records. Cached to NCBI_FETCH_CACHE_OUTPUT_FILE, replayable from NCBI_FETCH_CACHE_INPUT_FILE.
OUTPUT (tables written) - only when UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES is checked: db_link insert UniProtKB links for genes matched via a shared RefSeq accession; delete links whose accessions left UniProt record_attribution attributions for new and newly-supported links uniprot_release sets processed_date
REFERENCE TABLES (used for matching): db_link current UniProtKB and RefSeq accessions per gene (RefSeq is the matching key) marker gene lookup by ZDB ID record_attribution distinguishes curator-attributed from load-attributed links publication AUTOMATED_CURATION_OF_UNIPROT_DATABASE_LINKS - the attribution pub for every link this load adds uniprot_release selects the release file; blocks loading an older release over a newer one
See also: UniProt-Secondary-Term-Load (must run after this), Uniprot-Monthly-Diff-Load_m, UniProt-Release-Check_d.
Full I/O documentation: reference/data-load-jobs.md#uniprot-diff-load

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Check this option to commit the results of the load. Otherwise, it's a dry run.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: TIMESTAMP=`date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S` echo "WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE" echo "PWD=$PWD" echo "UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES=$UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES" rm -f $PWD/uniprot_load_report*.html $PWD/uniprot_context*.json $PWD/uniprot_load_report*.html.zip $PWD/uniprot_context*.json.zip export UNIPROT_OUTPUT_REPORT_FILE="$PWD/uniprot_load_report_$TIMESTAMP.html.zip" export UNIPROT_CONTEXT_FILE="$PWD/uniprot_context_$TIMESTAMP.json.zip" export NCBI_FETCH_CACHE_OUTPUT_FILE="$PWD/ncbi_refseq_api_results.json" cd $SOURCEROOT gradle uniprotLoadTask
